prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the edit target: the user's black-and-white ink avatar. Create ONE edited avatar, square canvas, white background, no captions, no sheet. Change ONLY the HAIR. Keep the identical face identity, original eye/mouth/nose positions, face scale and tilt, expression, thick hand-ink outline, collar, neck, black clothing, shoulder silhouette, composition and margins. Pure black ink and white negative space, no greys/shading/colour. This is a design reference to translate into SVG layers. Critical requirement: generous airy hair volume above and beside the scalp, at least as full and tall as the original reference hair, natural lifted roots, layered organic tufts, believable mass, asymmetry and tapering ends. NEVER slicked down or pressed against skull; NEVER a smooth helmet, plastic wig, geometric triangle bangs, thin skull cap, or tiny head. Keep eyes and eyebrows unobstructed. Hair should look professionally hand-drawn in the same style as the original. Preserve face/body rather than redrawing a different character. New hairstyle: an airy, fluffy short layered shag with a loose side part, lifted crown, overlapping swept fringe clumps, irregular soft wisps around the temples and outward feathered nape. Full and relaxed, not a close-cropped masculine cut. Dark solid masses with a few organic white separations; keep the original character's charm.
